description.en: OpenAI API key account type. The openai platform and its endpoints (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses, /v1/embeddings) are built into the core; model prices are set by administrators in the core.
description.zh: OpenAI API Key 账号类型（openai 平台及其端点 /v1/chat/completions、/v1/responses、/v1/embeddings 由核心内置；模型价格由管理员在核心中配置）。

description.en: An OpenAI Platform API key, or a key for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (set Base URL).
description.zh: OpenAI 平台的 API Key，或 OpenAI 兼容端点的 Key（需填写 Base URL）。

reason.en: Register the OpenAI API key account type for the built-in openai platform
reason.zh: 为内置 openai 平台注册 OpenAI API Key 账号类型

reason.en: Read the API key of accounts of its own account type (OpenAI API Key) to call the upstream API
reason.zh: 读取本插件账号类型（OpenAI API Key）账号的 API Key 以调用上游接口
